steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: Platform 3 secondary patrol complete. Target pod in position, no suspicious individuals detected.

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: There's no one else left on this little platform but us. What's the sitch on your end?

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: The four pods' engines have undergone breakpoint testing, and the park's about to enter the intercity net's range.

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: Remember the official line to the public: The gathering is only temporary, and they can all return to their respective exhibit areas once the broadcast's intro segment is done.

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: You sure everyone's gone on your end? The Tin Man stressed we had to make sure all park personnel are safely evacuated before we send the operation signal.

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: The main road was sealed off an hour ago, the support platform's emergency jump pads are all shut, and the cable car routes were all diverted to only go in one direction last night, so no one's been able to get in.

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: Better play it safe...

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Ropeway station needs backup. That Rhine research assistant is blocking the access hub with a group of testers, and it's hard to get around them...

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: Gah, go back them up. It's crucial we time this right, every preparatory step has to be complete before the broadcast begins.

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: What was that...?

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: Look, over here.

steps.name: Agent B
steps.text: A soda bottle cap?

steps.name: Agent A
steps.text: Probably rolled off the table from the floating pod shaking. It's probably nothing, let's go.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Phew... M-Mr. Aspen...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: What on earth is your obsession with that balloon?! The couch is small enough without you hanging onto that, I almost got squished flat!

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: I'm sorry, Miss Barn... but I begged you to take me here just for this balloon...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: You have no idea how much effort it took slipping right out from under their noses and then getting you here!

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Really sorry about that... could you hand me the toolbox from the closet? The evacuation announcement came so suddenly, I didn't have the time to make sure the floating pods would be alright during the stream...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: You want the Lucky Cystybeast on display at the expo that badly?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Ignoring a public hearing, signing a temp contract with a tour guide with multiple charges under her belt, and helping her escape park security just so you can have her bring you back to a sealed-off levitation layer...

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: You guys! All nuts for the sky!

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: I'm drowning in debt here. The only way to clear it is to have the Lucky Cystybeast at the show and draw in investors.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Yeah, yeah. 'The sky will answer every future seeker', and all that jazz. Propeller Paradise's slogan is plastered all over the place, trashcan lids in the slums included.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Even if it's blind faith, I'm not going to give up now after coming this far.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Phew... nothing wrong with the components. They'll last till the show ends. Let's go.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Why's the door locked?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Wait, did you hear that?

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: I did... don't tell me something's really up with my product?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: No, I don't mean the exhibit. From—

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Under our feet?

steps.name: Anxious Company Representative
steps.text: Grr, why isn't the line moving? Drag this out any longer and the broadcast is gonna start!

steps.name: Curious Tester
steps.text: Calm down, Maylander guys are on their way to handle it... they've got someone surrounded. Seems like a Rhine Lab researcher, judging by the uniform?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Let me through! The tree's hard drive and motherboard haven't been removed yet—

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: Don't push your luck!

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: Allowing the Rhine tree at the expo has been our biggest concession to Rhine Lab, and we've even been so generous as to let you copy the data for future research. What more do you want?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: I just need five minutes! I promise I won't pull any tricks either! Hasn't the ATAO's Science Consultant issued a report on the tree? It's completely harmless!

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: No. All levitation layer personnel are to return to the ground to ensure the exhibits are finalized, and only return after the opening speech.

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: Besides, the uplink cable cars aren't operating now, so there's no way you can reach the Rhine tree. It's at the highest point in the park.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: I didn't realize how much effort Director Lunorey put into this experiment until I saw the core code, and now I remember, how she never abandoned her dreams for the sky...

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Even if it only saves a little backtracking time later, I want to help her somehow... you have to let me through!

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: Mr. Jagger, one more move and we'll have to resort to more special methods.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Wait... the tree looks strange.

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: You used the same excuse ten minutes ago.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: No, no! It really looks weird! Look for yourself!

a.text: The expo is about to open, with the Columbian sun shining brightly. The crowd follows Sky's finger, and spots a dazzling tree.

The branches wrapped in special material should have been completely still, like tiny insects trapped in resin. However, right here and now under the sunlight, the broken branches seem to glow... green.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Organic materials don't photosynthesize...

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: The park handbook states clearly it is common for exhibits to transform in high-altitude environments.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Rhine stuff doesn't do that.

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: And it doesn't give you an excuse to go back up there.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Going up there won't solve the problem, I have no idea what exactly's going on...

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: But I know who does.

steps.name: Council Member
steps.text: Huh? He just left, that easily?

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: ...Levitation layer, eleven main platforms, and twenty support platforms have been inspected...

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: ...Jammers and backup detonators have been installed in nine smaller levitation pods, which will crash one-by-one when activated...

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: ...Personnel evacuation is complete. Scouts have done multiple calculations of the fallout curve based on current wind direction and force, and have confirmed falling debris will not reach the square serving as the evacuation spot...

steps.name: Agent
steps.text: All areas progressing well. Gustave sends word from the Cloud restaurant's cockpit that Propeller Paradise will be within D.C. intercity net range in five minutes.

steps.name: Agent
steps.text: Your orders, sir?

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Anyone seen those two newbies from Bravo?

steps.name: Agent
steps.text: The ones responsible for that Banshee? Positioning shows they're still on Platform 3. That's not in the plan's operation range. Should we send someone to check it out?

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Seems like their mission's been 'taken over'.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: Platform 3 is far from the detonation target, so don't worry about that. I'll handle it later.

steps.name: Tin Man
steps.text: All teams, sync chronos. Phase two begins now.
The jail cell window crops the sky into a tiny square.
The ordinary yet mysterious 'tree', centerpiece of Nasti's research, and Rhine Lab's core project, is now hidden from her view by strangely clothed figures and floating balloons.

In a few minutes, the expo broadcast will begin, without Nasti's involvement. Her bone pen and mechanical devices were seized earlier, so all she needs to do now is to play the role of a helpless sinner.
If Muelsyse were here, she'd probably summon eight water clones to scold her for being silly. But Nasti does not regret her decision, though there is one woman on her mind.
Væla leaving the Convallis had always left her uneasy. If the chance came...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Who's that?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Director Lunorey, you have to follow me to the tree platform!

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: You're supposed to be keeping the device data and core code safe. What are you doing here?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: But the 'tree' is growing now!

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: ...'Growing'? That's impossible.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: So that's not supposed to happen... If it affects the levitation module, it'll definitely be dangerous to anyone on the ground.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: The levitation module runs independently, with a backup power supply that can last for five days. But the abnormality you mentioned... the only way to find out why it's happening is to go inside the 'tree'.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Come with me, Director.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: The security cams have been rigged with a delayed feed that should buy us at least twenty minutes, and I'm not sure why, but the cell's smart locks are unlocked, so now's—
That's because the chief executive of 'Propeller Paradise' opened them for you.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Gordon?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: What's... all that on you? A DIY high-altitude face shield, modified propellers, and a second-hand insulated spacesuit?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Did you loot them from the park's scrap and recycle plant?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Your distorted testimony at the hearing is still up on the park's bulletin board, but now you're helping us escape...? Don't tell me you've had a sudden attack of conscience?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Nasti, I got your bone pen and devices here. Sorry about the hearing.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I'd rather stand in the defendant's dock with you than recite that prepared speech—after all, the confiscated devices were my goods anyways, so I'll take the blame for that.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: ...Who are you and what have you done with Gordon Tannen?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Park Broadcast
steps.text: My dear citizens of D.C., and those watching this live broadcast, it is my honor to introduce Propeller Paradise, an experimental park that is sure to leave its mark on Columbian history!

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: We don't have much time.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Nasti, you've done deals with Gustave. I'm sure you won't doubt the intel I'm about to hand over.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Your old boss is planning something with Maylander, correct?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: You're even sharper than I thought.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Seeing the park's chief executive here when he's supposed to be making a speech in half an hour is proof enough.

steps.name: Park Broadcast
steps.text: Friends, look out your windows, up at the sky. No amount of marketing bluster can compare to what you'll see with your own eyes, where the future among the clouds is waiting for you!

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: They want to can the expo with an accident that'll kill the future of Propeller Paradise, though I've no idea exactly what their plan is.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: If Maylander's involved, they'll move fast.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: What was that?

steps.name: Park Broadcast
steps.text: God, am I seeing things? Something's falling from the levitation layer—Is that the Lucky Cystybeast's floating pod?!

steps.name: Park Broadcast
steps.text: No, there's more! Three... four... Is this part of the opening ceremony? They didn't mention this in the script! If they really come crashing down—

steps.name: Park Broadcast
steps.text: Wait! The pods stopped falling? As if something's gripping them firmly...

steps.name: Park Broadcast
steps.text: Huh? What was that? Oh, oh! It seems the tech companies have prepared a surprise that even got me!

steps.name: Park Broadcast
steps.text: We have just witnessed Propeller Paradise's breakthrough in the field of levitation, with no need for papers or data, and this is only just the beginning!

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: No way, there's no emergency stop module—even in ongoing projects—that could've done that...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Sky, your field measurements are more precise. Where were the falling pods supposed to land?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: From visual estimates, they would have probably crashed into Platform 2, blocking the connecting lower layer tunnel—

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: That's the only path we can take to the tree.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Gordon, I accept your apology, but I have no time for your plans.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: That miracle was no stroke of luck. Might have something to do with you and your invention?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Is that a threat?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Just my intuitive judgment on all rule-breaking.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I don't need your help with Gustave, but I do need a bargaining chip to make sure Propeller Paradise stays afloat when everything's done and dusted.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: So my tree...

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Letting you handle something only you know how to handle is part of my plan.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Got it. Rhine Lab staff will cooperate with you.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: However. Whatever it is you're planning to do, go to the tree at the first sign of danger and I'll come get you.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Everything ready, Five-Four?

steps.name: Space Finbeast
steps.text: Preparations complete.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Let's go. I have an opening speech to make.
